fair_value_reason: The agents' corrected values ($73, $75, $68, $75, $70.5; mean $72.3) all reproduce from their stated inputs, and the convert and tax errors are fixed everywhere. I make no further correction. The contract-asset finding is already inside the FCF that the cash-based methods use, so it does not warrant a haircut. The P/E inputs ($2.70 FY28 EPS) are confirmed against consensus revenue. I keep $72, about 2% above the $70.7 close: fairly valued.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged to fair values of $68-75 (mean $72.3), but the convergence is mainly the agents adopting my round-1 corrections and per-agent numbers, not five independent confirmations. Only agent_4 (10-K contract assets) and agent_2 (Broadcom +29%) added verified new facts. The contract-asset build of $193M is real, comes from installment billing and is already a ~$130M drag inside FY26 FCF. It is a bear-tail and Q1 watch item, not a valuation haircut. I keep fair value at $72 (about 2% above $70.7) and nudge the ladder slightly below the mean in the middle (P>=71 0.522), with low confidence. There is no checked edge against the S&P 500 for a ~45%-vol name.
key_drivers: FY27 guide ($3.18-3.23B revenue, 24-25% non-GAAP margin, $850-950M FCF) already assumes server/DRAM constraints all year. Q1 FY27 (Nov 24 to Dec 2) is the first test.
FY28 non-GAAP EPS of ~$2.70 (20% tax, ~292M diluted shares; MarketScreener FY28 revenue $3.65B) x a 25-27.5x exit multiple gives ~$68-75. The multiple, not the facts, is now the whole disagreement.

Revenue and cash conversion: contract assets went from immaterial to $193M (6.8% of revenue) on installment billing. FCF absorbed a $130M drag and still grew 12%, and RPO rose 28% to $3.44B. Watch whether the build keeps outpacing revenue.
VMware exit demand vs Broadcom friction: VDDK now TAP-gated (confirmed), Broadcom software +29% on VCF pricing. Both the push to leave and the switching friction are rising.
SBC of $358M (12.5% of revenue) absorbs most buybacks. The $500M 2027 converts mature Oct 1, 2027, are in the money and are already in the diluted count.
